listen_address.description: IP address the iSNS server will bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '0.0.0.0')

listen_port.description: UDP port on which the iSNS server listens (default is 3205)

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (0 = quiet, 9 = very verbose). Recommend 3–6 for production.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stdout/stderr.

psk_file.description: Path to PSK file (only used when auth_mode = psk)

server_cert.description: Path to server TLS certificate (only used when auth_mode = cert)

server_key.description: Path to server TLS private key (only used when auth_mode = cert)

ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for client validation (only used when auth_mode = cert)

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent TCP sessions allowed

max_targets.description: Maximum number of targets that may be registered

max_initiators.description: Maximum number of initiators that may be registered

max_portals.description: Maximum number of portals that may be registered

max_nodes.description: Maximum total number of registered nodes (targets + initiators)

persistence_enabled.description: Enable disk persistence of the iSNS database

persist_file.description: Path to persistent database file (only used if persistence_enabled = true)

sync_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between database syncs to disk (0 = sync on every change only)

allowed_initiators.description: List of allowed initiator IQNs. Empty list means all initiators are allowed.

items.description: IQN of an allowed iSCSI initiator (e.g., 'iqn.1994-05.com.redhat:myhost')

allowed_targets.description: List of allowed target IQNs. Empty list means all targets are allowed.

items.description: IQN of an allowed iSCSI target (e.g., 'iqn.2003-01.org.example:storage')

heartbeat_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between iSNS heartbeats to registered nodes (0 = disabled)

discovery_domains_enabled.description: Enable discovery domain filtering (restricts node discovery per domain)

cluster_name.description: Optional name of this iSNS server in a cluster (used for multi-server sync)
